pages.text: The generator and the electric motor both need a $(item)magnet$() in their assembly, and so does the electric gauge. The $(item)polarizer$(), the machine that makes magnets, needs an electric gauge in its recipe and electricity to run. So where does the first magnet come from?

$(l)Craft it by hand$()$(br)Since 1.3.0 a magnet can be crafted at a crafting table:$(li)a $(item)magnetic alloy ingot$() in the center,$(li)a $(item)block of redstone$() above it, on its left and on its right,$(li)a $(item)compass$() below it.

It is expensive on purpose: craft just enough to build your first generator and electric gauge, then a polarizer.$(br2)$(l)Or call the lightning$()$(br)Lightning striking dropped magnetic alloy ingots turns them into magnets, but part of the stack is lost at random.
Once power flows, the $(item)polarizer$() turns magnetic alloy ingots into magnets cheaply (see $(item)Electric Machines$()).
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
